_about: What the ground does to the next shot. 'spin', 'lift' and 'spread' multiply the club's own; 'mishit' multiplies the odds of a fat, thin or shanked shot. Each terrain can sit the ball several ways: 'chance' is the share of balls that end up like that, 'power' is the share of the swing that reaches the ball. A 'plugged' sit is never rolled: the ball earns it by dropping steeply into sand.

sits.name: sitting up
sits.note: A flyer. It comes out hot with little spin, so it will run.

sits.name: sitting down
sits.note: Grass behind the ball. Expect to lose distance and spin.

sits.name: buried
sits.note: Buried. The grass will grab the club: just get it out.

sits.name: perched
sits.note: Perched on top of the grass. A lucky break.

sits.name: plugged
sits.note: Plugged. It will come out low with no spin and run.

sits.name: sunk in
sits.note: Sunk into the ash. It will come out heavy.

slope._about: A sloping stance. 'loft' is how many radians of launch a slope of 100% along the line adds, 'curve' how much sidespin a slope of 100% across it adds, 'flat' the slope below which nobody notices, and the 'max' values cap both.
